model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 GGUF Q5_0 7B
model.description: DiT GGUF Q5_0 (5.1 GB). Middle rung between Q4_K and Q8_0. Same 2.1 VAE and Qwen3-VL-8B encoder. No Lightning distill for 2.1 yet. License follows Qwen Research License.
model.selector_help: Lighter than Q8 when you want GGUF but not Q4 artifacts. On a 4090 prefer INT8 ConvRot. Default 1024.

resource_requirements.note: Good GGUF compromise. INT8 ConvRot is still the 4090 pick.
